# TFR UK rework v2 - part core: shared helpers for the ENG national spirits.
# Scope of every effect: ENG (country). Safe to call in any order.
# Generated by SCRATCH/build2/core_work/gen_core.py.

# Public (normally called through ENG_refresh_modifiers): enforces the cap table of contract 3.1.
# Only the bonus side is clamped (max for good-when-positive lines, min for good-when-negative lines),
# so no penalty can be dodged. Caps fixed by the contract are marked (contract).
ENG_clamp_spirit_variables = {
	# economy
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_eco_consumer_goods min = -0.2 }  # (contract)
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_eco_factory_output max = 0.15 }  # (contract)
	# ENG_eco_factory_output: the spirit reads ENG_eco_factory_output_total = ENG_eco_factory_output + ENG_eco_workshop_output, same cap
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_eco_workshop_output max = 0.05 }
	set_variable = { ENG_eco_factory_output_total = ENG_eco_factory_output }
	add_to_variable = { ENG_eco_factory_output_total = ENG_eco_workshop_output }
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_eco_factory_output_total max = 0.15 }  # (contract)
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_eco_dockyard_output max = 0.1 }  # (contract)
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_eco_civ_construction max = 0.15 }  # (contract)
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_eco_mil_construction max = 0.15 }  # (contract)
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_eco_dock_construction max = 0.2 }  # (contract)
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_eco_infra_construction max = 0.2 }  # (contract)
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_eco_efficiency_cap max = 0.105 }  # (contract)
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_eco_efficiency_gain max = 0.15 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_eco_start_efficiency max = 0.2 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_eco_line_retention max = 0.2 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_eco_research max = 0.1 }  # (contract)
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_eco_conversion min = -0.5 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_eco_resources max = 0.1 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_eco_slots max = 0.1 }
	# army
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_army_attack max = 0.1 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_army_defence max = 0.1 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_army_org max = 0.15 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_army_speed max = 0.1 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_army_planning max = 0.25 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_army_max_planning max = 0.2 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_army_doctrine_cost min = -0.3 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_army_training_time min = -0.25 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_army_supply min = -0.2 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_army_armor_attack max = 0.15 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_army_armor_defence max = 0.15 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_army_armor_speed max = 0.15 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_army_infantry_attack max = 0.15 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_army_infantry_defence max = 0.15 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_army_artillery_attack max = 0.15 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_army_special_forces_cap max = 0.1 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_army_special_forces_attack max = 0.2 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_army_breakthrough max = 0.15 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_army_recon max = 0.2 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_army_entrenchment max = 0.2 }

	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_army_invasion_prep min = -0.3 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_army_xp_gain max = 0.25 }
	# air
	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_air_attack max = 0.1 }

	clamp_variable = { var = ENG_air_agility max = 0.1 }

# Public: clamps every variable to its cap, then makes the shown spirits match the variables, then
# re-reads every variable at once (instead of waiting for the daily update).
# Use once at the end of a reward, inside hidden_effect:  hidden_effect = { ENG_refresh_modifiers = yes }
# Also run weekly by TFR_ENG_core_on_actions.txt and at startup as a safety net.
# Per spirit (review v2 #10 / #39, in-game fact 5):
#  1. economy / army: once every starting penalty is paid off, the copy index ENG_<spirit>_copy moves from
#     0 (penalty copy) to 1 (neutral base copy: The British Economy / The British Army);
#  2. a copy is removed when every variable of the spirit is 0, or when it is not the copy that
#     ENG_<spirit>_copy names (a rename);
#  3. when some variable is non-zero and no copy is shown, the copy named by ENG_<spirit>_copy is added.
# The copy index survives an all-zero period, so a renamed spirit comes back under its new name.
# A rename made while copy 0 is active waits in ENG_<spirit>_pending_copy and is applied at step 1.
ENG_refresh_modifiers = {
	ENG_clamp_spirit_variables = yes
	### economy
	# starting penalties paid off -> The British Economy
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ENG_economy_copy = 0 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { ENG_eco_factory_output < 0 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { ENG_eco_civ_construction < 0 } }
		}
		set_variable = { ENG_economy_copy = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ENG_economy_pending_copy > 1 } }
			set_variable = { ENG_economy_copy = ENG_economy_pending_copy }
		}
		clear_variable = ENG_economy_pending_copy
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ENG_economy_dyn }
			OR = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { ENG_economy_copy = 0 } }
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_consumer_goods > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_consumer_goods < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_factory_output_total > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_factory_output_total < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_dockyard_output > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_dockyard_output < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_civ_construction > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_civ_construction < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_mil_construction > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_mil_construction < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_dock_construction > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_dock_construction < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_infra_construction > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_infra_construction < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_efficiency_cap > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_efficiency_cap < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_efficiency_gain > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_efficiency_gain < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_start_efficiency > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_start_efficiency < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_line_retention > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_line_retention < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_research > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_research < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_conversion > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_conversion < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_resources > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_resources < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_slots > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_slots < 0 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ENG_economy_dyn }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ENG_economy_base_dyn }
			OR = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { ENG_economy_copy = 1 } }
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_consumer_goods > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_consumer_goods < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_factory_output_total > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_factory_output_total < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_dockyard_output > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_dockyard_output < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_civ_construction > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_civ_construction < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_mil_construction > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_mil_construction < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_dock_construction > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_dock_construction < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_infra_construction > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_infra_construction < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_efficiency_cap > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_efficiency_cap < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_efficiency_gain > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_efficiency_gain < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_start_efficiency > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_start_efficiency < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_line_retention > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_line_retention < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_research > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_research < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_conversion > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_conversion < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_resources > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_resources < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_slots > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_slots < 0 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ENG_economy_base_dyn }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ENG_economy_rearmament_dyn }
			OR = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { ENG_economy_copy = 2 } }
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_consumer_goods > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_consumer_goods < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_factory_output_total > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_factory_output_total < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_dockyard_output > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_dockyard_output < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_civ_construction > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_civ_construction < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_mil_construction > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_mil_construction < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_dock_construction > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_dock_construction < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_infra_construction > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_infra_construction < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_efficiency_cap > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_efficiency_cap < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_efficiency_gain > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_efficiency_gain < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_start_efficiency > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_start_efficiency < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_line_retention > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_line_retention < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_research > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_research < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_conversion > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_conversion < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_resources > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_resources < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_slots > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_slots < 0 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ENG_economy_rearmament_dyn }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ENG_economy_arsenal_dyn }
			OR = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { ENG_economy_copy = 3 } }
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_consumer_goods > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_consumer_goods < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_factory_output_total > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_factory_output_total < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_dockyard_output > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_dockyard_output < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_civ_construction > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_civ_construction < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_mil_construction > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_mil_construction < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_dock_construction > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_dock_construction < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_infra_construction > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_infra_construction < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_efficiency_cap > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_efficiency_cap < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_efficiency_gain > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_efficiency_gain < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_start_efficiency > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_start_efficiency < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_line_retention > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_line_retention < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_research > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_research < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_conversion > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_conversion < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_resources > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_resources < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_slots > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_slots < 0 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ENG_economy_arsenal_dyn }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ENG_economy_workshop_dyn }
			OR = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { ENG_economy_copy = 4 } }
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_consumer_goods > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_consumer_goods < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_factory_output_total > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_factory_output_total < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_dockyard_output > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_dockyard_output < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_civ_construction > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_civ_construction < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_mil_construction > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_mil_construction < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_dock_construction > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_dock_construction < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_infra_construction > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_infra_construction < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_efficiency_cap > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_efficiency_cap < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_efficiency_gain > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_efficiency_gain < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_start_efficiency > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_start_efficiency < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_line_retention > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_line_retention < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_research > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_research < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_conversion > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_conversion < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_resources > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_resources < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_slots > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_eco_slots < 0 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ENG_economy_workshop_dyn }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ENG_economy_dyn } }
			NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ENG_economy_base_dyn } }
			NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ENG_economy_rearmament_dyn } }
			NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ENG_economy_arsenal_dyn } }
			NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ENG_economy_workshop_dyn } }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { ENG_eco_consumer_goods > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_eco_consumer_goods < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_eco_factory_output_total > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_eco_factory_output_total < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_eco_dockyard_output > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_eco_dockyard_output < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_eco_civ_construction > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_eco_civ_construction < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_eco_mil_construction > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_eco_mil_construction < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_eco_dock_construction > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_eco_dock_construction < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_eco_infra_construction > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_eco_infra_construction < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_eco_efficiency_cap > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_eco_efficiency_cap < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_eco_efficiency_gain > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_eco_efficiency_gain < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_eco_start_efficiency > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_eco_start_efficiency < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_eco_line_retention > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_eco_line_retention < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_eco_research > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_eco_research < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_eco_conversion > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_eco_conversion < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_eco_resources > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_eco_resources < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_eco_slots > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_eco_slots < 0 }
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { ENG_economy_copy = 0 } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ENG_economy_dyn } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { ENG_economy_copy = 1 } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ENG_economy_base_dyn } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { ENG_economy_copy = 2 } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ENG_economy_rearmament_dyn } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { ENG_economy_copy = 3 } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ENG_economy_arsenal_dyn } }
		else = { add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ENG_economy_workshop_dyn } }
	}
	### army
	# starting penalties paid off -> The British Army
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ENG_army_copy = 0 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { ENG_army_planning < 0 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { ENG_army_doctrine_cost > 0 } }
		}
		set_variable = { ENG_army_copy = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ENG_army_pending_copy > 1 } }
			set_variable = { ENG_army_copy = ENG_army_pending_copy }
		}
		clear_variable = ENG_army_pending_copy
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ENG_army_dyn }
			OR = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { ENG_army_copy = 0 } }
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						check_variable = { ENG_army_attack > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_army_attack < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_army_defence > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_army_defence < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_army_org > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_army_org < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_army_speed > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_army_speed < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_army_planning > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_army_planning < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_army_max_planning > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_army_max_planning < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_army_doctrine_cost > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_army_doctrine_cost < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_army_training_time > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_army_training_time < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_army_supply > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_army_supply < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_army_armor_attack > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_army_armor_attack < 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_army_armor_defence > 0 }
						check_variable = { ENG_army_armor_defence < 0 }

	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ENG_navy_dyn } }
			NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ENG_navy_senior_service_dyn } }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_capital_attack > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_capital_attack < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_capital_defence > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_capital_defence < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_screen_attack > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_screen_attack < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_screen_defence > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_screen_defence < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_speed > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_speed < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_range > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_range < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_escort_efficiency > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_escort_efficiency < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_sub_detection > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_sub_detection < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_anti_air > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_anti_air < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_org > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_org < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_coordination > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_coordination < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_carrier_air_attack > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_carrier_air_attack < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_carrier_air_targeting > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_carrier_air_targeting < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_sortie > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_sortie < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_repair > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_repair < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_refit > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_refit < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_doctrine_cost > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_doctrine_cost < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_xp_gain > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_xp_gain < 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_invasion_capacity > 0 }
				check_variable = { ENG_navy_invasion_capacity < 0 }
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { ENG_navy_copy = 0 } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ENG_navy_dyn } }
		else = { add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ENG_navy_senior_service_dyn } }
	}
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
}

# Public: the economy spirit becomes "Rearmament Economy" (values kept: every copy reads the same variables).
# Never overrides a later name (Arsenal of Britain, Workshop of the World); prints its own tooltip either way.
ENG_rename_economy_to_rearmament = {
	# While the starting penalties are unpaid (ENG_economy_copy = 0) the rename waits in ENG_economy_pending_copy.
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { ENG_economy_copy = 3 }
				AND = { check_variable = { ENG_economy_copy = 0 } check_variable = { ENG_economy_pending_copy = 3 } }
				check_variable = { ENG_economy_copy = 4 }
				AND = { check_variable = { ENG_economy_copy = 0 } check_variable = { ENG_economy_pending_copy = 4 } }
			}
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = ENG_rename_economy_kept_tt
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ENG_economy_copy = 0 } }
		custom_effect_tooltip = ENG_rename_economy_to_rearmament_pending_tt
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { ENG_economy_pending_copy = 2 } }
	}
	else = {
		custom_effect_tooltip = ENG_rename_economy_to_rearmament_tt
		hidden_effect = {
			set_variable = { ENG_economy_copy = 2 }
			ENG_refresh_modifiers = yes
		}
	}
}
